The image shows a leaf with distinct white to light-gray, circular, dusty patches on its surface. This powdery appearance is a hallmark symptom of Powdery Mildew, a fungal disease that grows on the surface of leaves. The symptoms do not match the dark lesions of Anthracnose, the black coating of Sooty Mould, or the branch death characteristic of Die_Back.
